title: Code and data for "Layered national and provincial carbon policies in Sichuan and Chongqing: a small local temperature signal and little near-term heatwave relief"
description:
Code and data for the article "Layered national and provincial carbon policies in Sichuan and Chongqing: a small local temperature signal and little near-term heatwave relief" (Frontiers in Earth Science).

The archive contains the derived energy and CO₂ emission pathways for every pathway construction (NPI, NPR, NPLS and their variants), the GCAM-China emission projections for 2025–2060 used for NPLS, the FaIR emission inputs and 841-member ensemble temperature results, the regional scaling coefficients, the heatwave response curves and committed-exposure results, the data underlying Figures 1–5, Supplementary Figures S1–S4 and all tables, and the Python scripts that regenerate them (folder Research_package/). The two prepared ERA5-Land daily temperature arrays are stored in the folder parts/ as numbered parts of at most 10 MB; run python parts/join_parts.py and extract the restored zip files into the archive root to place them in Research_package/inputs/weather/.

Research_package/README.md describes the contents and how to run the analysis; Research_package/DATA_SOURCES.md lists the sources and licences of the third-party data.
